limitations.note: The agent fixed the shift direction but made match assert and deassert one clock earlier by comparing the newly shifted value instead of the pre-edge register value.
The test compared match against history after shifting it, so it passed the agent’s same-edge implementation rather than detecting the change to the original output timing.

The first combined edit-and-test command was rejected because of its cleanup command, and the Python retry failed because the executable was missing, so the agent had to resubmit the edit and repackage the test.
